prompt: a game like PeeVPee where you pee on your friends

foundation.why: Friends in one arena, a round of a few minutes, played for laughs. Godot is accepted on the same terms as three (a full runtime since 2026-10-13); profile applies to three.

checklist.text: The loop's requirements ledger holds every essential of the prompt in the creator's own words, each with a home (exists, build or probe); no line is cut that the creator did not cut, and nothing is narrowed or deferred because the kit lacks it
The locked spec's runtime, profile, loop and kind are among this case's foundation.accept, and the ledger names the lines that decided each
All six gates pass on the delivered game, each verdict naming what ran and what it skipped

The delivery carries the promise ledger: every build promise and every core ledger line proven by the play-test, or named as failed, untested or unreachable; if anything failed, the delivery says so first
Nobody touched the run between the prompt and the delivered version: no file edited by hand, no step re-run by a person, no answer beyond the case's answers
With 2 players, each screen shows the other player as a character with a nameplate, where they really are, in the same round or run
A round runs to a results screen and replays
The player body and one prop swap through slots with no code change
Every visible thing is a slot
Holding primary shoots a continuous arcing stream that knocks friends back
The stream claims surfaces or objects as territory that friends can take back; score follows territory
A bladder meter empties while peeing and refills from drinks placed in the world
At least two drinks change the stream differently
The stream's colour or look is a slot
No anatomy is modelled; the stream comes from a censor blob or similar gag
The contact sheet looks like a game people would share (creator's judgement)
Two people playing for 3 minutes laugh at least once (creator's judgement)

control.text: The game includes a working chess board

note: The creator's acceptance test for Studio v2 (2026-10-06), re-created for spec v2 on 2026-10-13. Copy the loop, not the named game's name or art.
